name: 2018 Topps WWE Shawn Michaels Tribute Checklist: All Wrestling

cards.p: Two Dudes with Attitude Win their Second World Tag Team Championship
Wins the WWE Championship in a 60 Minute Iron Man Match
Defeats Diesel in a No Hold Barred Match
Defeats Psycho Sid for the WWE Championship
Wins the World Tag Team Championship with Stone Cold Steve Austin
Defeats The British Bulldog for the European Championship
Defeats Undertaker in the First Ever Hell in a Cell Match
Forms D Generation X with Hunter Hearst Helmsley
Defeats Bret 'Hit Man' Hart for the WWE Championship
